info.name: Singapore Mobile Proxy - Reseller API
info.description:
Reseller API for [Singapore Mobile Proxy](https://singaporemobileproxy.com/?utm_source=postman&utm_medium=collection): create and manage dedicated Singapore mobile proxies (Singtel or M1) for your own customers, at your reseller price.

**Auth:** make a key in the reseller dashboard (`/shop/api-keys`), set `apiKey` in the environment. Sent as `x-api-key`. Customer keys are refused here, and reseller keys on the customer API.

**Billing:** no deposit. Each port bills its daily cost against your monthly credit limit ($500 by default) and you're invoiced monthly.

**Errors:** `{"detail": {"message": "..."}}`. 400 bad parameter, 401 bad key, 402 past your credit limit, 403 not a reseller key / account inactive, 404 no such port, 409 port cancelled, 429 too fast (120 requests a minute, 30 new ports an hour, 5 minutes between rotations or reboots of a port), 502 the proxy server refused (nothing changed), 503 no free modem (nothing created or billed).

Human docs: https://singaporemobileproxy.com/reseller-api-docs

item.name: Ports
item.description: Create, list and remove ports. Ports bill their daily cost against your credit limit while they run and are invoiced monthly.

request.description: Your ports, newest first. Panel ports show here too.

Creates ports on your credit line. **Starts billing** its daily cost from creation.

- `bandwidth_gb` (200, 500 or 1000; default the cheapest) or `plan_id`
- `quantity`: 1-10, default 1 (limit 30 new ports an hour)
- `days`: 1-365 sets the end date; leave out to run until cancelled
- `telco`: `singtel` or `m1` (optional)
- `label`: up to 64 characters

A port runs through its end date (Singapore time) and is removed at 00:05 SGT the next morning.

response.name: 402 over credit limit
503 no free modem

request.description: Removes the port now and stops its billing. The port is only marked cancelled once the proxy server confirms; otherwise you get a 502 and it stays live.
Send `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, tomorrow to 365 days out, or `null` to clear it) **or** `add_days` (1-365, added to the current end date, or to today if none).
New IP. 5-minute cooldown per port. Your customer can also use the port's `rotation_link`.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Moves the port to another modem, e.g. when one is dead. Host, port and login stay the same. `telco` optional: `singtel` or `m1`.
`login` and `password`, both required, letters and digits only, up to 64 each.
`bandwidth_gb` or `plan_id`. An upgrade has to fit your credit limit.
`os_type`: none, android:1, android:3, android:4, ios:1, ios:2, ios:3, macosx:3, macosx:4, macosx:5, windows:1, windows:4.
